title: Sonlar 1-10
hook_voice: Lesson ten. Numbers from one to ten.
end_say: Saqlab qo'ying! Ertaga o'n birinchi dars: sonlar va yosh.
caption:
0 dan ingliz tili, 10-dars: inglizcha sonlar, 1 dan 10 gacha.

One, two, three — Bir, ikki, uch
Four, five, six — To'rt, besh, olti
Seven, eight, nine, ten — Yetti, sakkiz, to'qqiz, o'n

Izohda 1 dan 10 gacha inglizcha sanab yozing!
Saqlab qo'ying va ingliz tilini boshlamoqchi bo'lgan do'stingizga yuboring.
Ertaga 11-dars: Sonlar 11-20 va yosh.
